annotations.text:
Waypoint app icon — four marks to replace the teal square + violet dot. Each: the icon at home-screen, settings and notification sizes, then the in-app lockup on light and dark. Same app colours (teal #00838E, violet #6A69DB).
A · Play pin — a pin whose eye is a play button: a place found in a video. Most on-message for TikTok capture; pins are common in map apps.
B · Route W — the W drawn as a route through stops, ending in a violet waypoint. Most ownable monogram; reads as a letter first, a map second.
C · Two pins — your place and a friend's, overlapping. Says 'shared'; the only light icon, which stands out on a busy home screen but is busier at small sizes.
D · Save pin — a bookmark with a pin's eye: saving a place. Violet leads, so it breaks from the teal UI.
Pick one and I'll make it the app icon and the in-app logo.
